questions.stem: Why are around 80% of Data Science projects said to be failing?
options: Because of a lack of structured data
Because of the absence of Data Citizen roles
Because Data Scientists lack SQL skills
questions.explanation: The claim is that if 80% or so of Data Science projects fail, it is because Data Citizen roles are missing.

questions.stem: Which skill set characterises a Data Analyst?
options: Excel, databases using SQL, reports and dashboards
Deep learning frameworks and GPU programming
questions.explanation: Data Analysts are functional consultants with skills in Excel, SQL databases, reports and dashboards, used to dig into and present management KPIs.

questions.stem: To whom are a Data Analyst's analysis results passed for productionisation of data pipelines?
questions.explanation: Analysts' results are handed to ETL/ELT developers or Data Engineers, who implement the data pipelines for production.

questions.stem: What kind of tools do Data Citizens use to create, test and process machine learning models?
questions.explanation: Data Citizens do initial data science analysis with drag-and-drop tools and use low-code or no-code tools to run and test models.

questions.stem: To whom do Data Citizens pass their models so they can be implemented for production?
questions.explanation: The models prepared by Data Citizens are passed to Data Scientists, who implement the ML models for productionisation.

questions.stem: Data Citizens are described as a bridge between which two roles?
options: Data Engineers and Chief Data Officers
questions.explanation: Data Citizens sit between Data Analysts and Data Scientists, doing initial machine learning work within their domain.

questions.stem: Which existing role is predicted to merge into the Data Citizen role?
questions.explanation: It is suggested that Data Analyst roles will soon merge into Data Citizens.

questions.stem: At what level within an organisation do Data Citizens operate?
options: At the domain or department level
Only within the central IT function
Only within the Data Science team
Across the whole enterprise without departmental boundaries
questions.explanation: A critical point is that Data Citizens work at the domain or department level, remaining within the boundaries of their department.

questions.stem: What trend in data usage is given as the reason Data Analyst roles will merge into Data Citizens?
options: The removal of SQL from most databases
The use of semi-structured and unstructured data has taken over the use of structured data
The fall in the cost of Data Scientists
questions.explanation: Because semi-structured and unstructured data now dominate over structured data, the analyst role is expected to evolve into the Data Citizen role.

questions.stem: Which statement about Data Citizens is NOT correct?
options: They are functional consultants with machine learning skill sets
They can do the activities a Data Scientist does, within their department
They are already an established norm in every department
They predict KPIs for business and management using ML models
They use low-code or no-code tools to run and test models
questions.explanation: The Data Citizen role has not yet been identified as a norm, although it is expected to become a must-have role in every department.
